programme.desc: 'S47/E1 - Beat The Judge: Alex'. Three champions are determined to defeat judge Alex Guarnaschelli. They are challenged to create a dish using rainbow soup dumplings and cheddar cheese sauce.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S36/E9 - DDD Budget Battle'. Four chefs from Diners, Drive-ins, and Dives compete to see who can make the best meals on a budget, including some seafood favourites.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S33/E12 - Hot New Takes'. The chefs bring the heat with spicy new recipes, including fiery quesabirria tacos, kicked-up tangy noodles and two different kinds of wild wings.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S5/E3 - Triple D Nation: Mexi-Cali'. Guy Fieri chows down on South-of-the-Border bites throughout California. He tastes monster sandwiches, Chile Verde and top-notch tampiquena.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E7 - All-American Showdown: North'. Four Northern chefs battle to see who will represent their region in the $50,000 finale, and they start off with a strange paste in the appetiser round.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S15/E6 - Bolognesed And Confused'. A chef must flip their shrimp stir-fry ingredients into a chef's hat. And, the chefs have to cook their Bolognese dish in espresso devices.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S35/E8 - Relay: Winners Vs. Judges'. Guy Fieri hosts a competition between three previous winners and three judges. The teams must cook up a seafood platter in relay.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S22/E6 - Timesaving Tips'. The team shares timesaving tips for simple meals packed with flavour. Jeff Mauro contributes his Cuban slider bake, and Geoffrey Zakarian prepares a roasted salmon.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S47/E2 - Beat The Judge: Scott'. Three champions set out to take down judge Scott Conant. The first-round basket contains canned shrimp, popcorn gelato and mortadella.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - Easter: Pulling A Rabbit Out Of A... Crown'. Sunny Anderson pulls a 'yoke' on the five remaining bakers when she asks them to make edible bird's nest desserts filled with Easter eggs.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Easter: Dinner Dupe'. Sunny Anderson asks the remaining bakers to make over-the-top charcuterie boards filled with Easter treats. Then, the competitors try to fool the judges.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Easter: Basket Case'. The remaining bakers take on the ultimate final challenge: a 4-foot-tall edible Easter basket filled with over-the-top desserts and the ultimate Easter cake.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S36/E10 - Red Light Special Extravaganza'. Guy Fieri challenges four chefs to prepare a fried feast using Flavortown Market's red light specials as mandatory ingredients.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S31/E10 - From Beef To Bao'. Guy Fieri tastes a funky peanut butter burger at a joint in Logan, Utah. Plus, he tucks into bomb bao buns served out of a tiny trailer in Juneau, Alaska.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S31/E11 - Hometown Inspiration'. Guy Fieri heads to Portland, Oregon, to visit a spot putting a vegan spin on Israeli flavours. Plus, Louisiana specialities are on the menu in Logan, Utah.

programme.title: Chopped Junior
programme.desc: 'S6/E11 - Make Me A Judge: 3'. Four kids tackle mystery baskets with a baking theme in an attempt to earn the third and final seat at the judges' table.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S7/E1 - Triple D Nation: Sweet, Savory'. Guy Fieri's headed back for top-tier tenderloin in Memphis, short rib gnocchi near Boston, and out-of-this-world wagyu in Lackawanna, NY.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S7/E2 - Triple D Nation: BBQ To Boxty'. Guy Fieri revisits real-deal barbecue in San Antonio, veggie-loaded lasagne in Jersey, and killer potato cakes in Syracuse, NY.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S6/E11 - The Big Dip'. The chefs make deli-worthy dishes before completing a grand gesture. The final stakeout comes down to a difficult decision between two dipped dishes.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S33/E13 - Top Notch Tea Party'. The gang throw a playful tea party with easy asparagus and tomato quiche, cornmeal scones, millionaire bars and more!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S5/E4 - Triple D Nation: Wrapped'. A relocated Filipino spot in California has spicy pork fries worth the commute. Then, a Colorado staple celebrates a century of college-town classics.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E8 - All-American Showdown: East'. Chefs from the East battle to make it to the final. For the appetiser, a dish from the Keystone State must be combined with a Big Apple cocktail.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Simple Pleasures
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - A Taste Of Travel'. Rachel serves up recipes from her culinary travels. They include Irish soda bread with a French tapenade, Swedish cookies, and potato croquettes with sauerkraut.

programme.title: Rachel Khoo's Simple Pleasures
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Larder Love'. Rachel digs deep into the larder to create a crab and pineapple tartare, a Mediterranean-inspired cannelloni dish, and meringue and praline kisses made without eggs.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S5/E1 - Nicole Mann'. Astronaut Nicole Mann joins Ina to share stories from her time in orbit. Ina bakes an apple crostata and gives a masterclass in seared scallops.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S5/E2 - David Remnick'. Ina Garten makes overnight Belgium waffles for Pulitzer Prize-winning author David Remnick before hosting a parmesan chicken cooking class.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Through The Milkshake Glass'. Host Sunny Anderson challenges the four remaining bakers to make Easter flavours milkshakes. The judges then decide who will be sent home.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Macaron Macaroon'. Zoë prepares delicate chocolate macarons for a bakers' gathering with a fellow cookbook author and friend. Plus, she makes rustic haystack macaroons.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S15/E7 - Beam Me Up, Alton'. The chefs prep boil dishes through an inter-dimensional rift, wear robot arms while they make a melt and prep their freeze while dodging bullets in slow motion.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S36/E1 - Relay: Ultimate Face-Off'. Guy Fieri sets up the ultimate face-off with a tag-team relay between two sets of chefs. They must create a spicy champion's dinner.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E12 - Triple D Nation: American Eats'. Guy Fieri checks in on some amped-up American eats, like funky fritters in Phoenix, mind-blowing pancakes in New York and snapper soup in Indiana.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S4/E1 - Triple D Nation: New Tastes'. Guy Fieri finds new takes on the classics! He visits a place in Palm Desert, California, that serves avocado fries and a burger with an Italian accent.

programme.desc: 'S4/E9 - A Trip Down Memory Lane'. After getting some unexpected love from their friends and family back home, the contenders pour their hearts into some seriously nostalgic barbecue.

programme.desc: 'S2/E234'. Esther stuns at a press conference, Nenna worries about Joey, Shireen suggests fertility help, and Brenda makes a life-changing decision.

programme.title: Blink Kant Bo
programme.desc: 'S3/E56'. Suna refuses to reconcile with Abidin. As Halis warns of retaliation, Ifakat is kidnapped and assaulted before being returned, leaving the family shaken and facing a chilling threat.

programme.title: Chrysalis
programme.desc: 'S3/E92'. Turkan has a nightmare that upsets herself and Nalan. Hayri is playing with fire.

programme.title: Die Vertroueling
programme.desc: 'S1/E43'. Ilhan and Aziz must learn to navigate the dangerous waters of prison life. Meanwhile, Savas plans an ambush on Marasli and Mahnoor. Will they be able to escape unscathed?

programme.title: The Other Wife
programme.desc: 'S1/E83'. As tensions rise, Ferit is caught between Selin and Leyla. The weight of family expectations and hidden feelings threaten to tear them apart-can he choose his path?

programme.title: Naagin
programme.desc: 'S4/E30'. Vishaka tells Shalakha that she has to get Dev away from Brinda if she wants to make a place in his life and replace Brinda. Shalakha behaves very romantically with Dev and convinces him to go on a honeymoon with her.
